verdict.rationale: The Slack channel monitor automation opens a conversation from an @openhands mention and replies in Slack when the agent finishes, which is a form of completion notification. Automations can also integrate with Slack and other tools. That coverage is limited to the Slack-triggered workflow. Missing for 10: notifications when the agent needs input or approval, general completion alerts for CLI/GUI/cloud sessions (desktop, email or push), configurable notification settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
